resolution.question: Will Dr. Tanaka and her two co-authors upload their revised manuscript before the journal's fourteen-day resubmission deadline expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the revised manuscript was successfully uploaded to the journal's submission system before 2026-09-07T23:59:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
